text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Fitted black crewneck tee, loose beige pleated wide-leg trousers, tan brown shoes.
original_prompt: Edit this white-background hollow outfit. Change the cream colored neckline trim and sleeve cuff trim of the black T-shirt to solid black matching the rest of the shirt. The T-shirt must be entirely plain black without contrast edging. Preserve all other details, beige trousers, shoes, hollow no-person structure, white background and framing.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
